source: synthetic Monte Carlo; no physical acquisition or DMA
interpretation: Conditional model discrimination only; no physics validation or RH proof

assumptions.noise: Independent N(0,sigma^2) response errors; sigma specified, never residual-fitted
assumptions.units: Response rad; reference in declared displacement units
assumptions.intercept: Common proper Gaussian prior integrated analytically; sd=0 is a point intercept
assumptions.simulation_intercept: Each replication draws b from the same declared prior
assumptions.duration: T=M/fs only conditional on independent observations, not oversampled FIR outputs
assumptions.phase_caveat: Independent Gaussian phase errors require a high-SNR approximation and covariance calibration
assumptions.decision: Strict log BF10 > threshold_log_bf; natural logarithm
assumptions.replications: H1 and H0 share random numbers; trials independent within each hypothesis

analytic_snr_benchmark.model: High-SNR independent equally noisy dual IF phase channels
analytic_snr_benchmark.reference_norm: sum(x_i^2)=M*reference_std^2, centered and orthogonal to nuisance trends
analytic_snr_benchmark.caveat: Analytic approximation, not a measured or FIR-corrected uncertainty
